<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';

withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Action icon. Add a visually hidden label for screen readers.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-group-action"
    data-sidebar="group-action"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-group-action"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-sidebar-group-action {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.875rem;
  right: 0.75rem;
  display: flex;
  width: 1.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--foreground);
  outline: none;
  transition: transform 150ms;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-group-action:hover {
  background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
  color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-group-action:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-group-action > svg {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-group-action::after {
  position: absolute;
  content: "";
  inset: -0.5rem;
}

@media (width >= 768px) {
  .sigma-ui-sidebar-group-action::after {
    display: none;
  }
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-group-action {
  display: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';

withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps>(), {
  as: 'div',
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Label text, optionally with an icon.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-group-label"
    data-sidebar="group-label"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-group-label"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-sidebar-group-label {
  display: flex;
  height: 2rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 0.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  outline: none;
  transition: margin 200ms linear, opacity 200ms linear;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-group-label:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-group-label > svg {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-group-label {
  margin-top: -2rem;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

/** Current value of the input; use with `v-model`. */
const model = defineModel<string | number>();

defineEmits<{
  /** Emitted when the user changes the value. */
  'update:modelValue': [value: string | number];
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Input
    v-model="model"
    data-slot="sidebar-input"
    data-sidebar="input"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-input"
  />
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-input.sigma-ui-sidebar-input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 2rem;
  background-color: var(--background);
  box-shadow: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Main page content rendered next to the sidebar.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <main
    data-slot="sidebar-inset"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-inset"
  >
    <slot />
  </main>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-sidebar-inset {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: var(--background);
}

@media (width >= 768px) {
  .sigma-ui-sidebar[data-variant="inset"] ~ .sigma-ui-sidebar-inset {
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    margin: 0.5rem;
    margin-left: 0;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%);
  }

  .sigma-ui-sidebar[data-variant="inset"][data-state="collapsed"] ~ .sigma-ui-sidebar-inset {
    margin-left: 0.5rem;
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';

interface SidebarMenuActionProps extends PrimitiveProps {
  /**
   * Shows the action only while the menu item is hovered or focused.
   */
  showOnHover?: boolean;
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SidebarMenuActionProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  showOnHover: false,
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Action icon. Add a visually hidden label for screen readers.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-action"
    data-sidebar="menu-action"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action"
    :class="{ 'sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action--show-on-hover': showOnHover }"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.375rem;
  right: 0.25rem;
  display: flex;
  width: 1.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--foreground);
  outline: none;
  transition: transform 150ms;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action:hover,
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button:hover ~ .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action {
  color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action:hover {
  background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action > svg {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action::after {
  position: absolute;
  content: "";
  inset: -0.5rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-size="sm"] ~ .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action {
  top: 0.25rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-size="lg"] ~ .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action {
  top: 0.625rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action {
  display: none;
}

@media (width >= 768px) {
  .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action::after {
    display: none;
  }

  .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action--show-on-hover {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-item:hover .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action--show-on-hover,
  .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-item:focus-within .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action--show-on-hover,
  .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action--show-on-hover[data-state="open"] {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue';
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core';
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tooltip';
import SidebarMenuButtonChild, { type SidebarMenuButtonProps } from './SidebarMenuButtonChild.vue';
import { useSidebar } from './utils';

interface Props extends SidebarMenuButtonProps {
  /**
   * Tooltip shown when the sidebar is collapsed to icons. Accepts a string or a component.
   */
  tooltip?: string | Component;
}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  as: 'button',
  variant: 'default',
  size: 'default',
  isActive: false,
  tooltip: undefined,
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Button content, usually an icon followed by a `<span>` label.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();

const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar();

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'tooltip');
</script>

<template>
  <SidebarMenuButtonChild
    v-if="!tooltip"
    v-bind="{ ...delegatedProps, ...$attrs }"
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
  >
    <slot />
  </SidebarMenuButtonChild>

  <Tooltip
    v-else
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
  >
    <TooltipTrigger as-child>
      <SidebarMenuButtonChild v-bind="{ ...delegatedProps, ...$attrs }">
        <slot />
      </SidebarMenuButtonChild>
    </TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent
      side="right"
      align="center"
      :hidden="state !== 'collapsed' || isMobile"
    >
      <template v-if="typeof tooltip === 'string'">
        {{ tooltip }}
      </template>
      <component
        :is="tooltip"
        v-else
      />
    </TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { type SidebarMenuButtonVariants, sidebarMenuButtonVariants } from '.';

export interface SidebarMenuButtonProps extends PrimitiveProps {
  /**
   * Visual style of the button.
   */
  variant?: SidebarMenuButtonVariants['variant'];
  /**
   * Height and text size of the button.
   */
  size?: SidebarMenuButtonVariants['size'];
  /**
   * Marks the button as the current page or section.
   */
  isActive?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SidebarMenuButtonProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  variant: 'default',
  size: 'default',
  isActive: false,
});
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
    data-sidebar="menu-button"
    :data-size="size"
    :data-active="props.isActive"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :class="[sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), $attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button {
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  outline: none;
  text-align: left;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: width 200ms linear, height 200ms linear, padding 200ms linear;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button:hover,
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button:active,
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-active="true"],
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-state="open"]:hover {
  background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
  color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button[data-active="true"] {
  font-weight: 500;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button:disabled,
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button > svg {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button > span:last-child {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-item:has(.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-action) .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button {
  padding-right: 2rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button--outline {
  background-color: var(--background);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button--size-default {
  height: 2rem;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button--size-sm {
  height: 1.75rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button--size-lg {
  height: 3rem;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button {
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  padding: 0.5rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-button--size-lg {
  padding: 0;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';

interface SidebarMenuSubButtonProps extends PrimitiveProps {
  /**
   * Text size of the button.
   */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
  /**
   * Marks the button as the current page.
   */
  isActive?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SidebarMenuSubButtonProps>(), {
  as: 'a',
  size: 'md',
  isActive: false,
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Button content, usually a `<span>` label.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-sub-button"
    data-sidebar="menu-sub-button"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :data-size="size"
    :data-active="props.isActive"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button {
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 1.75rem;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 0.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--foreground);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  outline: none;
  text-decoration: none;
  transform: translateX(-1px);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button[data-size="sm"] {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button:hover,
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button:active,
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button[data-active="true"] {
  background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
  color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button:disabled,
.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button > svg {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button > span:last-child {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-menu-sub-button {
  display: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useSidebar } from './utils';

const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar();
</script>

<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    data-sidebar="rail"
    data-slot="sidebar-rail"
    aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
    title="Toggle Sidebar"
    :tabindex="-1"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-rail"
    @click="toggleSidebar"
  >
    <slot />
  </button>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 20;
  display: none;
  width: 1rem;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background-color: transparent;
  inset-block: 0;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  transition: all 150ms linear;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-rail::after {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  width: 2px;
  content: "";
  inset-block: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-rail:hover::after {
  background-color: var(--border);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-side="left"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
  right: -1rem;
  cursor: w-resize;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-side="right"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
  left: 0;
  cursor: e-resize;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-side="left"][data-state="collapsed"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
  cursor: e-resize;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-side="right"][data-state="collapsed"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
  cursor: w-resize;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="offcanvas"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="offcanvas"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail::after {
  left: 100%;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-collapsible="offcanvas"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail:hover {
  background-color: var(--background);
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-side="left"][data-collapsible="offcanvas"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
  right: -0.5rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar[data-side="right"][data-collapsible="offcanvas"] .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
  left: -0.5rem;
}

@media (width >= 640px) {
  .sigma-ui-sidebar-rail {
    display: flex;
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
</script>

<template>
  <Separator
    data-slot="sidebar-separator"
    data-sidebar="separator"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-separator"
  />
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-separator.sigma-ui-sidebar-separator {
  width: auto;
  margin: 0 0.5rem;
  background-color: var(--border);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { PanelLeftIcon } from 'lucide-vue-next';
import { VisuallyHidden } from 'reka-ui';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useSidebar } from './utils';

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Custom trigger icon. Defaults to a panel icon.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();

const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar();
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    data-sidebar="trigger"
    data-slot="sidebar-trigger"
    variant="ghost"
    size="icon"
    class="sigma-ui-sidebar-trigger"
    @click="toggleSidebar"
  >
    <slot>
      <PanelLeftIcon class="sigma-ui-sidebar-trigger__icon" />
    </slot>
    <VisuallyHidden>Toggle Sidebar</VisuallyHidden>
  </Button>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-button.sigma-ui-sidebar-trigger {
  width: 1.75rem;
  height: 1.75rem;
}

.sigma-ui-sidebar-trigger__icon {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
}
</style>
